validity.researcher_notes: Orchestrator asked me to establish which named, dated filing 'P7859 2026 Expansion' actually is, and whether it is distinct from the 2024 and 2028 rows. It is FERC Docket No. CP25-209-000, an NGA section 7(b)/7(c) certificate application Great Basin filed 4/15/2025 for its '2026 Expansion Project' (FR 2025-07744; confirmed again by the docket-specific scoping notice FR 2025-09917, titled '...for the Proposed 2026 Great Basin Expansion Project,' and the EA-availability notice FR 2025-21711, same docket). This is a DIFFERENT docket, DIFFERENT filing date, and DIFFERENT physical scope (2.32-4.67 mi loop/replacement, 8,129 Dth/d) than: (a) the 2024 Expansion (P7857) -- FERC Docket No. CP23-466-000, filed 5/1/2023 (FR 2023-10738), 0.25 mi of 20-inch loop (Carson Lateral, Storey Co.) + 2.88 mi of 10-inch->20-inch replacement (Carson Lateral, Lyon Co.) + 0.28 mi of 12-inch loop (South Tahoe Lateral, Douglas Co.) = 3.41 mi total (matches P7857's recorded 3.41 exactly), 5,674 Dth/d incremental capacity, $14,939,850 estimated cost; and (b) the 2028 Expansion (P7860) -- as of 4/30/2026 still in FERC PRE-FILING Docket No. PF26-5-000 (FR 2026-08459), a materially larger project spanning six counties (Churchill, Humboldt, Lyon, Pershing, Storey, Washoe) involving 'construction and operation of new facilities AND abandonment of existing facilities' -- consistent with EIA's own May/Aug 2026 releases, which explicitly distinguish 'a smaller 2026 Expansion (~8,129 Dth/d)... filed FERC CP25-209-000 on 4/15/2025' from the 'Larger 2028 Expansion in pre-filing discussions with FERC' (~800-1,760 MMcf/d incremental capacity, $1,700M, in-service 2028 per EIA Jan/May/Aug 2026 'Great Basin Expansion Project' row). Three genuinely separate, sequential, growing-in-scope expansion filings on the same system -- not a relabeling or double-count. Facts on the sibling rows routed via cross_row_leads, not staged onto their sheets.

cross_row_leads.facts: P7857 '2024 Expansion' = FERC Docket No. CP23-466-000, filed 5/1/2023 (FR 2023-10738). Scope: (1) ~0.25 mi of new 20-inch loop on the Carson Lateral, Storey County NV; (2) ~2.88 mi of existing 10-inch pipe replaced with new 20-inch pipe, Carson Lateral, Lyon County NV; (3) ~0.28 mi of new 12-inch loop on the South Tahoe Lateral, Douglas County NV. Total 0.25+2.88+0.28=3.41 mi (matches P7857's recorded LengthKnown=3.41 exactly -- unlike P7859, this total is NOT undercounted). Capacity: 5,674 Dth/d (~5.67 MMcf/d) incremental firm transportation for two existing shippers. Estimated cost: $14,939,850 (~$14.94M). Related FERC notices for the same docket: Notice of Scoping (2023-13265, 6/22/2023) and Notice of Schedule for EA preparation (2023-14987, 7/14/2023) -- worth checking for a later EA-availability/certificate notice to establish current status/StartYear.

P7860 '2028 Expansion' is, as of 4/30/2026, still in FERC PRE-FILING Docket No. PF26-5-000 (FR 2026-08459) -- no certificate application has been filed yet, only pre-filing environmental review. Scope spans SIX counties (Churchill, Humboldt, Lyon, Pershing, Storey, Washoe), NV, and explicitly involves 'construction and operation of new facilities AND abandonment of existing facilities' -- a materially larger/different-shaped project than the 2024 or 2026 Expansions. EIA's own 'Great Basin Expansion Project' entries (Jan/May/Aug 2026 releases; sheet 'Natural Gas Pipeline Projects', excel rows 54/55/57) track this project: in-service year 2028, 0 new miles recorded by EIA (an intrastate/compression-heavy scope per EIA's own coding), cost $1,700M, additional capacity 1,760 MMcf/d (Jan2026 release) revised down to 800 MMcf/d (May/Aug2026 releases) -- EIA's own notes flag the capacity revision explicitly and separately confirm this 2028 project is distinct from the smaller CP25-209-000 (2026 Expansion, this row). Docket number on the EIA May2026 row (CP25-209-000) appears to be a carryover/labeling error in EIA's own workbook -- EIA's Aug2026 release row for the same project leaves docket_number blank, and the pre-filing docket is actually PF26-5-000 per the Federal Register. Worth flagging to whoever researches P7860 that EIA's docket field for this project is unreliable and the FR pre-filing notice (2026-08459) is the better citation for docket number.
